#   fixture    needs the gitignored RAW fixtures (skip-passes without them,

#   host       talks to a host service (keychain, FileProvider, network,
#              PhotoKit, server admin) the runner cannot provide

#   untriaged  not yet reviewed for the runner — move it to run.txt, or
#              give it a real tag, when the class is next touched

# tools/check-swift-regressions-coverage.py's initial sweep (#3460); a
# note that turns out wrong is a one-line fix, not a gate failure.
